notes.title: PUNK WARS: Prologue now available for FREE! Full version coming November 11!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello all [b]Punk Wars[/b] fans![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281766/a1df79f5731895cebc34e96527d693dca5289b55.gif[/img]

As promised we are delighted to inform that the free Prologue is now available! And we are also happy to announce that the [b]full version of the game will be out on November 11, 2021[/b]! So once again we would like to invite you to add the game to your Steam Wishlist!

[h2]FREE Punk Wars: Prologue:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761860
Punk Wars: Prologue will give you a taste of the full version of the game. Become the powerful leader of the Steampunk faction and defeat the Dieselpunk corporation before you run out of turns! Explore the ruins of a bygone civilization, where resources are scarce and the dangers way too common. Develop your infrastructure and technology that will secure your triumph. Create a winning strategy and a playstyle for your faction, utilising its own distinctive skills and units.

[h2]Full version (coming November 11, 2021):[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1541790

Also make sure to share your feedback and thoughts on the game in the Community section of the Steam page. Thank you all for your constant support!
